rationale: The exploratory experiment executed in a clean copy (f1728ea5be4a4676a8d7dffffa305f57, completed, exit 0). Both seeds completed their 300 steps and neither emitted a safety_violation event, so the five monitors were satisfied throughout the explored scope: one leader per term, applied entries immutable per node and index, identical entries for the same index across nodes, committed index monotonic per node, and every previously applied entry present in the log of a state machine reporting itself leader. This update interprets that retained receipt for the exploration question with no defect judgment, records the bounded negative as durable knowledge with its indices, and states its limits explicitly rather than treating zero detections as absence.

knowledge.statement: In the explored scope, no safety monitor reported a violation. Both seeds ran 300 driver steps over three real raft state machines with lossy, reordering-prone delivery and changing connectivity masks: seed 11 recorded 93 proposals, 9 campaigns, 12 leader-transfer requests, 434 messages delivered, 286 dropped and 19 distinct applied indexes; seed 23 recorded 95 proposals, 10 campaigns, 8 transfers, 303 delivered, 280 dropped and 10 distinct applied indexes. The event stream from that run contains no safety_violation event, so one leader per term, immutability of applied entries per node and index, cross-node agreement for an index, per-node commit monotonicity, and presence of previously applied entries in the log of a reporting leader were all unchecked-false in that scope.
knowledge.conditions: Exploratory basis without a fixed requirement: three state machines (ids 1,2,3, ElectionTick 10, HeartbeatTick 1) with in-memory storage whose ConfState is {1,2,3}; 300 steps per seed; per-node connectivity masks redrawn at random, per-message drop decisions, random ticks, random member proposals, random campaigns and random transfer requests; committed entries applied through the captured log interface with monitors checked after every step; membership changes deliberately not injected.

interpretations.rationale: Both summary events report zero violations for their seed (parsed indices 36 and 37), and the retained event stream contains no safety_violation event, which is the only channel through which the monitors report: the test emits safety_violation with the seed, invariant, detail and step for every monitor failure, and one summary per seed. The monitors cover the four classic Raft safety properties plus commit monotonicity, are evaluated after every step, and are driven by real state machines rather than by supplied state: committed entries are applied through the captured log interface and persisted through the in-memory storage. The counters show the scenario was exercised rather than idle (93 and 95 proposals, 9 and 10 campaigns, 12 and 8 transfers, hundreds of messages delivered and dropped, 19 and 10 distinct applied indexes), so the negative is not an artifact of a quiescent run. No defect is claimed from this result: it is a bounded exploration whose value is excluding these interleavings as an easy counterexample source, and the absence of detections is not evidence of absence. Zero detections in a randomized search also carries no occurrence-rate bound, and the applied-index counts show that heavy loss kept commit progress low, so the exploration sampled elections and transfers more densely than committed writes.

knowledge.assertion: both explored seeds completed with zero reported safety violations across the five monitors

counterevidence: The deterministic finding from the other investigation was reproduced inside the same execution before the exploration ran (its events appear earlier in the same receipt), so the negative reported here is not a statement that the snapshot behaves correctly everywhere.

Election timings inside the exploration are drawn from crypto/rand through the captured randomized election timeout, so the sampled interleavings differ between runs; the driver seed only fixes the driver's own choices and the exact counters in the knowledge entry describe this run.
limitations: Bounded scope: two seeds, 300 steps each, three nodes, no membership changes, no snapshots, no restarts, no crash-stop faults; other seeds, larger groups and slower or bursty loss patterns were not explored.
Zero detections establish neither absence nor an occurrence rate; the monitors are a finite check on the observed interleavings.
The monitors check safety-style invariants only; they say nothing about liveness, and the counting evidence shows commit progress was limited because many messages were dropped.
Randomized election timeouts make the exploration non-reproducible in detail, so a later rerun samples different interleavings even with the same driver seed.
